Then, on a grey morning after a storm, he saw a green glass bottle wedged between two rocks. Inside was a page folded small, the ink blurred but readable. 'To whoever tends the light: your beam brought us home last March. We were lost in fog and had given up. Thank you.' It was signed by a ship's crew he had never met. Elias read it three times, then climbed the spiral stairs and polished the great lens until it shone. That night he lit it early, and for the first time in years he smiled at the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街道上投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍在无人的路口按时变换。早点铺的卷帘门刚刚拉起，蒸笼冒出第一缕白气，老板揉着惺忪的睡眼开始和面。清洁工推着车缓缓走过，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。远处的高楼大多熄了灯，只剩几扇窗亮着，不知是谁还在熬夜，又或是谁刚刚醒来。风带着一丝凉意，掠过空旷的广场。天边还是深蓝色，但东方已隐约透出一线微白。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a job by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- It is like nesting dolls: open one, find a smaller doll inside, and keep going until you reach the tiniest one.\n- You need a stopping point, a smallest case with an easy answer, so the copies do not go on forever."}
